address: 1 Pearson Square, London, W1T 3BF, United Kingdom
bio: Luke Ahearne and Stevie Parle got together in 2025 to open this contemporary restaurant on the ground floor of a new block. ‘London-Italian’ is the way they describe the menu, which translates as dishes that are less about tradition and more about being Italian in flavour. So carbonara comes with agnolotti pasta, for example, and rib-eye with a chianti sauce; portion sizes are mixed, so it’s worth coming in a group to share. The restaurant is big and boldly decorated, and it's a good idea to start off with a cocktail in the bar.
